title: Canonical Segment 100 Knowledge Catalog
purpose: Single entry point for source-derived Segment 100 knowledge, applicability, validation boundaries, and training evidence.

systemBoundary.aiSolution: Generates BR, TS, TC, request/response JSON, and traceability artifacts.
systemBoundary.testSolution: Independently validates AI artifacts against this catalog and ATL105 source evidence.
systemBoundary.fiservExecution: Consumes AI-generated converter-ready JSON after independent validation.
systemBoundary.sourceOfTruth: ATL105 2026-3 specification and canonical source anchors

knowledgeCategories.scope: 17 ordered fields, lengths, separators, and serialization
Appendix E/G Prompt Code and card/transaction combinations
EMV, NFC, fleet, fuel, EBT, purchase-card, variable information, and Moneris triggers
Financial response, response families, approval, decline, and additional information
Original/follow-up identity, completion, cancellation, reversal, void, timeout, TOR, and retries
Segment 103, eWIC operations, WIC/EBT program data
Premium Gift Card, token, TransArmor, CA keys, wallet, and Moneris boundaries

statusPolicy.COVERED: Source, implementation, and artifact evidence agree.
statusPolicy.READY_FOR_AI_INTAKE: Independent oracle and tests are ready; AI artifact evidence is not yet supplied.
statusPolicy.PARTIALLY_COVERED: Some source or implementation evidence exists, but coverage is incomplete.
statusPolicy.REVIEW_REQUIRED: Specialized, conditional, external, or ambiguous evidence requires review.
statusPolicy.BLOCKED: Required source, implementation, or artifact evidence is missing.

trainingRule: Do not infer behavior from field names alone; resolve transaction, card, network, lifecycle, companion, response, appendix, and specialized-domain context first.
finalCertificationGate: Requires actual AI artifacts, applicable review decisions, and external ATL105 converter execution.
